qa.notes: Onboarding docs and installer contract are internally consistent for this sdp_lab PR. Public sdp mirror drift is tracked as post-merge publish work, not a pre-merge blocker.

summary: APPROVED: PR #152 fixes repo-local onboarding verification and stale PATH documentation. The public sdp installer publish remains tracked in sdplab-m034 and must run after merge because the public installer clones sdp_lab main.

findings_detail.title: Public installer mirror drift must be resolved after sdp_lab merge
findings_detail.rationale: The public installer URL can only become true after this sdp_lab PR lands, because the installer defaults to cloning fall-out-bug/sdp_lab main. Publishing the branch to fall-out-bug/sdp before merge would still clone the old sdp_lab main. This is a post-merge release gate, not a blocker for merging the source PR.
findings_detail.suggested_fix: After merging PR #152 to sdp_lab main, run scripts/sdp-publish.sh, verify the public raw installer matches scripts/install.sh, and then close sdplab-m034.
findings_detail.dedupe_key: P0:scripts/install.sh:public installer mirror drift after sdp_lab merge
